WHERE MCC_CODE='3115' AND H = 'D';


DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_MERCHANTCODE]
WHERE MCC_CODE='7251' AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_MERCHANTCODE] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20240705','20240708');


INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_MERCHANTCODE]
(
	  H
	,[BANK_CODE]
	,[SOURCE_SYSTEM]
	,[MCC_CODE]
	,[MERCHANT_CATEGORY]
	,[SPEND_CATEGORY]
	,[ESSENTIAL_TAG]
	,[FILE_NAME]
	,[insert_dttm]
)
SELECT 
	'D' H
	,[BANK_CODE]
	,[SOURCE_SYSTEM]
	,'999999' [MCC_CODE]
	,[MERCHANT_CATEGORY]
	,[SPEND_CATEGORY]
	,[ESSENTIAL_TAG]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_MERCHANTCODE]  WHERE MCC_CODE='3115' AND H = 'D';
